ambient_events: The generator changes note for a moment, finds it again, and carries on.
Wind comes off the flats and puts a fine grey dust over everything at ankle height.
Somebody cranks something at the far end of the shed, swears, and cranks it again.
The chalked column of hours on the wall gets one more mark. Nobody watches it go up.
A truck out on the hardstand ticks as it cools.
description: The shed floor, high enough to stand a trailer in and long enough to stand two. Diesel, cold iron, and the flat mineral smell the flats push in under the door. Trucks nose-in along one wall; along the other, drums, a bench, and a bulb on a flex burning steady in a region where nothing electric is supposed to work at all. Nobody here remarks on that. The door stands open on the flats south.
name: The Dry Run — the shed
